_readme: THE config file for the Ladies of Destiny agent. pageId/pageName/igUserId/igUsername/pageAccessToken are AUTO-FILLED the first time a valid token is provided (paste a fresh Graph API Explorer token into data/meta-token.txt and push, or run the workflow once). To change posting time: edit 'slots' (EAT). Owner rule 2026-10-07: one post per day at 09:00 EAT (TLP 06:00, LOD 09:00, BTM 12:00 — staggered through the day). To pause: set autoPost=false. IG catch-up window after slot time: graceMinutes (420 = 09:00-16:00 EAT, 7 hours; owner rule 2026-10-07 moved this page to 09:00 EAT and widened the window so a bad GitHub day still catches an afternoon landing — past it sibling pages force-rescue the same afternoon, and the force button posts just the IG half). Mutual rescue: 'siblings' lists the pages this agent watches — any landed run here dispatches a sibling whose IG half is due but has no landed run of its own (token: dispatchToken in this file — owner's PERMANENT PAT since 2026-10-07, never remove its repo scopes (the 10-05 scope loss silently killed the rescue net and caused missed posts on 10-01 and 10-07)).
